title: Happily Ever After Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Happily Ever After is a 4 BR / 3.5 BA / 11 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Completely remodeled in 2016, this 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home sleeps 11 with simply amazing coastal style.
description_expanded: Description56 TUPELO STREET2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 2 FULLS, 1 DAYBED, 1 SOFABED (SLEEPS 13)Welcome to Happily Ever After in Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Happily Ever After, a recently renovated and impeccably maintained luxury vacation home located in the heart of Seaside proper. Just 300 feet from beach access and only five homes in from the Gulf on coveted Tupelo Street, this exceptional property is ideal for family reunions, girls’ trips, and multi-generational or multi-family vacations. With thoughtful expansions, designer furnishings, and multiple living areas, this home offers space, comfort, and an unbeatable location near the beach.Prime Location & Outdoor LivingPerfectly positioned near the Gulf, Happily Ever After features a private driveway, a spacious L-shaped wraparound front porch, and stunning tower and Gulf views. The porch is furnished with rocking chairs and plush sofa seating—an inviting place to relax, enjoy the coastal breeze, and watch life unfold in Seaside. A New Orleans–style mahogany front door with a gas lantern sets the tone for the charm found throughout the home.Grand Living Spaces & Designer InteriorsStep inside to a light-filled, open-concept floor plan highlighted by a dramatic 22-foot cathedral ceiling. The main living room offers two distinct seating areas—one with four slipcovered chairs surrounding a white marble coffee table, and another with a plush white sofa, club chairs, a custom coffee table, and a large wall-mounted flat-screen TV for movie nights. Original artwork and fun paintings add personality and warmth throughout the space.Chef’s Kitchen & Dining for a CrowdThe adjacent dining room features walls of windows overlooking a peaceful pocket park and a large dining table that seats up to 12 guests, perfect for memorable family meals. The magazine-worthy kitchen is a true showstopper with quartz countertops, designer tile, open shelving, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and premium chef’s appliances. A spacious island provides bar seating for three, making it easy to gather and entertain.Spa-Like Baths & Main-Level Primary SuiteOff the central living area, a convenient half bath opens to an elegant, spa-inspired outdoor shower space featuring a Calazzo shower, ipe flooring, and a built-in bench—easily functioning as an additional full bath. The first-floor primary suite includes a king bed, wall-mounted TV, and a private ensuite bathroom with a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower, built-in bench, glass block window, and a vibrant turquoise vanity.Upstairs Bedrooms & Flexible Sleeping SpacesUpstairs, two bedrooms sit at either end of a hallway overlooking the great room and share a charming hall bath with a tub/shower combination. The front bedroom offers a queen bed, dual closets, and views of Tupelo Street. The oversized third bedroom includes two full beds, a daybed, seating area, large flat-screen TV, and ample storage, providing plenty of room for kids or additional guests.Private Tower Cottage Guest HouseJust outside the main home, past a covered porch and laundry closet with stacked washer/dryer, you’ll find the Tower Cottage, offering privacy while keeping everyone close. This guest house features a king bedroom downstairs with an adjoining living area and an efficiency kitchen equipped with a bar sink, microwave, refrigerator and freezer drawers, open shelving, and coffee maker. The bathroom includes a walk-in shower and built-in storage. Upstairs, the fifth bedroom features custom built-in bunk beds for two, a cozy seating area with sofa, a large flat-screen TV, and custom cabinetry.Iconic Tower with Panoramic ViewsOne of the home’s most memorable features is the covered open-air tower, offering breathtaking panoramic views of Seaside, the Gulf of Mexico, and unforgettable sunsets. Furnished with Adirondack chairs, this serene perch is the perfect place to unwind, toast the day, and savor the magic of Seaside.Happily Ever After truly lives up to its name—an exceptional Seaside vacation home where comfort, style, and location come together to create lasting memories.* 5 night minimum Summer, Spring & Spring Break; 3 night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Only Five bedroom home available during peak demand times of Summer and Spring Break. Durning the off season Happily Ever After 3 and Happily Ever After Tower can be rented separately for Fall, Fall Break, Winter, and Spring. FEATURES2,405 square feet, updated and recently renovated308 feet or 1-minute walk to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at Tupelo Pavilion, the largest private beach on 30AGenerous open-air front porch with outdoor lounge seatingPrivate drivewayWasher and dryerGas grillPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeBeach towels providedAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedThree parking passes issued for this home. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002372
